title: fix(components,i18n): name the data table pager's four page buttons (objectui#12124)
body:
Fixes #12124

Clause-②: yes

The `data-table` renderer's pager, which an ungrouped paged `ObjectGrid` draws, rendered first / previous / next / last as four `Button size="icon"` whose only child was a chevron icon. None had an accessible name, so a screen reader announced four unnamed buttons. Each now carries an `aria-label` read through the file's own `useTableTranslation`. No literal English. A grouped grid with more than one page of groups draws `ObjectGrid`'s own group pager instead; that pager is not covered here and is tracked as objectui#12143.

| Button | Key | en | zh |
|---|---|---|---|
| first | `table.firstPage` | First page | 第一页 |
| previous | `table.previousPage` | Previous page | 上一页 |
| next | `table.nextPage` | Next page | 下一页 |
| last | `table.lastPage` | Last page | 最后一页 |

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`: four `aria-label={t('table.KEY')}` attributes on the pager buttons, and the four rows in `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, the provider-less stand-in for the `en` pack.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: the four keys in the `table` block of all ten packs, each a real translation, placed after `pageInfo`. The names follow the namespace's camelCase and the `previousPage` / `nextPage` spelling the packs already use elsewhere.
- `.changeset/12124-pager-button-names.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` minor (four pack keys), `@object-ui/components` patch.

`Clause-②: yes` is the claim's reading (comment 6108325399): the four keys widen `@object-ui/i18n`'s published packs, so `TranslationKeys` (derived from the `as const` `en` pack) gains four members. Triage graded it `no`; the isolated contract review decides.

## Pins

- New `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/pagerButtonNames-12124.test.tsx`, through a real paged `ObjectGrid` (12 rows, pages of 5):
  - no provider: `getByRole('button', { name })` finds each of the four by the `en` pack's value, and each is driven. A click lands on the page its name promises; first and previous are disabled on page 1, next and last on the last page. So two swapped keys go red, not only a missing one.
  - under `zh`: each is found by the zh pack's value, each zh value differs from the en one, and no button carries the English name.
- Switched: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx`, the objectui#12123 test. Its next-page lookup `document.querySelector('button svg.lucide-chevron-right.h-4')?.closest('button')` is now `screen.getByRole('button', { name: en.table.nextPage })`.

## Evidence (HEAD `cae900c`)

The defect, and each pin's ability to fail. Each leg was run from the committed fix and restored; after each, the file's blob equals the HEAD blob `1d85896` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| Leg | Mutation (landing proven on disk) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A, the BASE renderer | `data-table.tsx` replaced by its BASE blob `fbc18df` (packs and tests at HEAD); pager `aria-label` count on disk 0 | 3 failed / 18 passed: `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "button" and name "First page"`, the same for `"Next page"` in the switched footer test, and for `"下一页"` under zh |
| B, one label ablated | `aria-label={t('table.nextPage')}` to `data-ablated=…` via objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `1d85896` to `475ebf9` | 3 failed: `"Next page"` twice, `"下一页"` once |
| C, first and last swapped | two nested `ablation-replace` runs, each anchor 1 to 0 | 2 failed, both at `expect(button('firstPage')).toBeDisabled()`: `Received element is not disabled` |

At HEAD the same two files run 21 passed (2 files).

## Gates (all at HEAD `cae900c`)

- Build: dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' run build`, then the rest of `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s closure (components, fields, permissions, providers, mobile, plugin-detail). Both exited 0; `packages/i18n/dist/locales/en.d.ts` carries `firstPage`.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, `@object-ui/components type-check` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` all exit 0. The plugin-grid test project lists both touched test files (`tsc --listFilesOnly`).
- Tests, repo-root form: `packages/i18n/` plus `RelatedList.serverpagination.test.tsx` (its `/next/i` role query shares a screen with a data-table): 83 files passed. `packages/components/` in 4 shards: 94, 94, 94 and 92 passed (1 skipped), 375 files in all. Ratchets `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: 2 passed. Root suite `scripts/__tests__/` in 3 shards: 60 (1 skipped), 59 (1 skipped) and 60 passed, 181 files in all.
- i18n family: `check:i18n-keys` (every `createSafeTranslation` defaults row repeats the `en` value), `check:i18n-drift` (4 keys added, 0 `en` values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report; none of the four listed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`: all exit 0.
- Others, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence.mjs` (13 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset), `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`.
- Lint, package form (`eslint` from each package dir, inline config honoured) on the 13 touched files: 0 errors. 34 warnings, all in `data-table.tsx` and none on a changed line; BASE's `data-table.tsx` has the same 34.
- Eager closure. Measured at the package dist, by removing exactly the added lines from the HEAD build: `components/dist/index.js` +315 B raw, +75 B gzip-9; `i18n/dist/locales/en.js` +134 B raw, +17 B gzip-9. The console-build delta (minified, chunked) and `check:eager-locale-catalogues` are NOT MEASURED. Reason: both need the whole workspace plus `apps/console` built. No import or specifier moved, so the catalogue composition that gate weighs is unchanged by construction. `performance-budget.yml` measures both in CI.

## Acceptance notes

Two findings outside this card, left untouched. Both are handed to the seat in the report.

- **The grouped grid's pager has the same four unnamed buttons.** `ObjectGrid`'s own `groupedPager` (in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) draws first / previous / next / last as icon-only `Button`s with no name. It renders for every grouped grid with more than one page of groups. It already reads `table.rowsPerPage` and `table.pageInfo`, so the four keys this change adds are the ones it needs. Not edited here: the file is outside the claim's file surface. Its own tests find these buttons by DOM position (`groupedPagination.test.tsx`: "The next chevron is the 3rd of the 4 nav buttons"). The in-process role-query probe is NOT MEASURED: the verify lock answered queue-timeout twice.
- **The row-actions trigger's name is literal English.** The data table's row menu trigger carries `aria-label="Row actions"` in every locale. A localization gap, not a missing name. Code read only; the zh probe is NOT MEASURED for the same reason.

Not in this change: the other tests that reach a pager button by position (`groupedPagination.test.tsx`, `serverPagination.test.tsx`, `data-table-manual-pagination.test.tsx`) keep their lookups. The card names only the objectui#12123 test.
